instagram_caption:
Jesus... I parked outside church this morning. I never went in.

Five years away. He sat in the car and watched everyone walk past his window.

He was sure they would stare. He was sure he would feel nothing.

Jesus: "I was not waiting at the door to stare. I was waiting to say your name."

"Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland."
Isaiah 43:18-19 (NIV)

The past drove you to that parking lot. It does not get to keep you in the car.

youtube_title: Jesus... I Parked Outside Church And Couldn't Go In | Isaiah 43:18-19 #Shorts
youtube_description:
Jesus... I parked outside church this morning. I never went in.

Five years away from church. He drove there, parked, and watched everyone walk past his window. He never opened the door.

Him: Jesus... I parked outside church this morning. I never went in.

Him: Five years away. I sat in the car and watched everyone walk past my window.

Jesus: I saw you. You drove there. That was not nothing.

Him: But they all know why I left. They will stare at me.

Jesus: Some might. I was not waiting at the door to stare. I was waiting to say your name.

Him: What if I walk in and still feel nothing? Then I wasted the drive.

Jesus: Then sit in the back and feel nothing with Me. I am not asking you to feel ready. Just come in.

"Forget the former things; do not dwell on the past. See, I am doing a new thing! Now it springs up; do you not perceive it? I am making a way in the wilderness and streams in the wasteland."
Isaiah 43:18-19 (NIV)

Jesus: The past drove you to that parking lot. It does not get to keep you in the car.

Jesus's Replies — the questions you actually ask, answered in His words.
